rooms.1: A garish carnival fun house facade at night: a giant grinning clown face forming the entrance, strings of coloured bulbs, a red-and-white striped awning, a starry purple sky, grey pavement in front. Leave the left and right foreground clear.
rooms.2: A magical mirror room in a fun house: tall distorting mirror panels in gilded frames lining the walls in perspective, warped reflections, purple wallpaper, a wooden plank floor; the middle of the far wall is a plain purple panel.
rooms.3: A small landing inside a fun house painted violet and blue: a dark doorway in the far wall, a rickety wooden staircase rising up the right-hand side, a wooden floor.
rooms.4: A fun house room beside a large riveted metal water tank that fills the far wall, its middle a plain riveted panel, a metal ladder running up the right side, pale walls and a plank floor.
rooms.5: Inside an empty glass-walled water tank in a fun house, its tiled floor with a round drain grate in the middle, glass walls and rivets, dim blue light, no water.
rooms.6: A hidden mad-scientist laboratory: white tiled walls, an oscilloscope with a glowing green trace on the right wall, a workbench with bubbling flasks on the left; the middle of the far wall is a plain white wall.
rooms.7: Riding a carousel horse: looking forward over a painted wooden horse's head and flowing mane, a red-and-white striped canopy above, blurred carnival lights spinning past.
rooms.8: A small plain room in a fun house with mustard-yellow walls, a red stripe at waist height, and an empty wooden floor.
rooms.9: A sloping hallway in a fun house tilted at a crazy angle, red and purple walls, black stripes, a dark opening at the far end.
rooms.10: A cramped fun house room with a very low ceiling of dark boards, mustard-yellow plank walls, an empty wooden floor.
rooms.11: Inside a giant rolling wooden barrel in a fun house: curved wooden staves and iron hoops all around, spinning, a round opening at the far end.
rooms.12: A fun house store room: wooden shelves stacked with boxes and props on the right part of the far wall, a plank floor; the left wall and the right wall are bare.
rooms.13: The bottom of a manhole shaft: iron rungs climbing the curved stone wall to a round opening of night sky far above.
rooms.14: A carnival shooting gallery booth: rows of yellow tin ducks on a conveyor across a blue backdrop, a red-and-white striped counter in front.
rooms.15: A narrow ledge high in a dark cavernous space inside a fun house: a doorway in the stone wall behind, and below the ledge a deep black pit.
rooms.16: The bottom of a deep pit inside a fun house: rough dark walls rising up, a gravel floor, faint light from above.
rooms.17: A dim observation chamber: grey walls, a small stool, a stone floor; the far wall bare.
rooms.18: Standing on the rotating platform of a carousel: the striped canopy overhead, the mirrored centre column with lights, other painted horses blurred at the edges; the middle of the platform empty.
rooms.19: A windy hallway in a fun house: blue walls in perspective, gusts blowing scraps of paper through the air.
rooms.20: A rickety wooden staircase climbing steeply through darkness, broken steps, a thin handrail.
rooms.21: A huge dim hall with a very tall ceiling: circus bunting and drapes, purple and red walls, an empty wooden floor.
rooms.22: On top of a carousel ride: the red-and-white striped canvas roof sloping away below, a gold finial, steel girders and darkness above.
rooms.23: A small fun house room with mustard-yellow walls and a plank floor, a small framed sign on the wall (blank, no writing); the middle of the floor empty.
rooms.24: A small plain fun house room with mustard-yellow walls, a red stripe at waist height, a plank floor.
rooms.25: A large plain room with beige panelled walls and a plank floor, empty and echoing.
rooms.26: A deserted carnival parking lot at night: faded white parking lines on cracked asphalt, the fun house glowing in the distance, a parked red sedan on the right, a starry purple sky.
rooms.27: Bouncing high on a trampoline in a small yellow room, looking down at the blue trampoline mat with springs around its edge.
rooms.28: A sewer system: a brick tunnel with a channel of murky green water, dripping pipes, darkness ahead.
rooms.29: A windy maze in a fun house: narrow corridors of brightly painted panels in pink, yellow and blue, a gust of wind, a dark gap ahead.
rooms.30: A windy maze in a fun house: narrow corridors of painted panels in purple and orange turning a corner, wind blowing.
rooms.31: A windy maze in a fun house: identical narrow corridors of pink and yellow panels branching left and right, wind blowing.
rooms.32: A windy maze in a fun house: a dead end of painted blue and magenta panels, wind howling.
rooms.33: A metal catwalk high in the dark rafters of a fun house, a railing along one side, girders and shadows; a bare brick wall at the far end.
rooms.34: A long round tunnel made of concentric rings, receding to a tiny dark circle, a ringed floor underfoot.
rooms.35: Death: a sinister clown face with X marks over its eyes, red nose and frozen grin, looming out of darkness.
